Marta (CS): LineaBank weekly health check. Quick snapshot: tokens 920k (flat), avg batch 2.1, cache hit rate 9% (down 4pp), cost per 1k tokens $2.85 (up 18%). p95 latency 310ms stable. Need root cause for hit-rate drop and cost increase before renewal workshop.
Ravi (Eng): Pulling recent access logs. Noting a client SDK change rolled out yesterday that switches to connect_timeout=30ms. Could be reducing batching.
Sofia (SRE): Yep saw that too. Batching coalesce window dropped due to shorter client sockets. That explains avg_batch 2.1 and hit drop. Cache misses are higher because requests arriving separately miss prefix alignment.
Ken (PM): Renewal in 12 days. If this is SDK-driven, we can ask them to roll back or we can make server-side accommodations. What's the risk if we do server-side only?
Ravi (Eng): Server-side mitigation: implement short-term request coalescing buffer per-client ip for 60ms regardless of client timeout. Risk: slight increase in tail latency for some flows, but we can limit to non-interactive endpoints.
Sofia (SRE): Also suggest proactive prefetch for frequent prompt prefixes (top 500 queries). That could recover ~3-4pp hit rate. I'll run a sweep to generate the prefix list.
Marta (CS): Can we estimate cost impact if we recover 3pp hit rate and bump avg batch to 3.5? Need a slide-friendly number.
Ravi (Eng): Back-of-envelope: current $2.85/1k. If hit rate +3pp and batch ->3.5, expect cost down ~11% => ~$2.54/1k. Not as good as org target but helpful.
Ken (PM): Action items: (1) Marta to ask client to roll back SDK change (ask for exact revert by EOD); (2) Ravi to deploy server-side short coalesce buffer limited to non-interactive routes (PR today); (3) Sofia to produce prefix list and run prefetech job candidate tomorrow; (4) Marta to update renewal deck with new numbers.
finance-bot: Alert: LineaBank MRR run-rate $12.4k, monthly delta -6%.
Marta (CS): I'll ping the account and ask for rollback. If they refuse, we go server-side + prefetch plan.
Ravi (Eng): Drafted config snippet for the coalesce buffer:
```
service.lineabank.batching:
  client_coalesce_override_ms: 60
  apply_to_routes: ["/v1/generate", "/v1/complete"]
  exclude_interactive: true
```
Sofia (SRE): Prefetch job note: will seed top-500 prefixes, warm cache during low-traffic hours 02:00-04:00 UTC. Expect ~+3pp hit in 24h. Link to job plan: https://redwood.internal/jobs/prefetch-lineabank
Marta (CS): Great. I'll summarize for the renewal slide: root cause (client SDK timeout), mitigation (rollback request + server-side coalesce + prefetch), cost estimate (~$2.54/1k). Will share draft by noon.
Ken (PM): Good. Keep me looped on client reply.
Ravi (Eng): Will open PR once tests pass.
Sofia (SRE): I'll update runbook with the temporary coalesce override and prefetch steps.
Marta (CS): Thanks team — check-in complete. :white_check_mark:
